name: @rivi/workspace-ios
description: RIVI Workspace for iPhone: the workspace as a native SwiftUI app on iOS 26 with Liquid Glass, over the Workspace API for native clients

scripts.kit:test: cd WorkspaceKit && swift build && swift test
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project RIVIWorkspace.xcodeproj -scheme Workspace -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -quiet build
scripts.verify: pnpm run project && git diff --exit-code --stat -- RIVIWorkspace.xcodeproj && pnpm run kit:test && pnpm run ios:build
